Definition: from G3313; to part, i.e. (literally) to apportion, bestow, share, or (figuratively) to disunite, differ:--deal, be difference between, distribute, divide, give part.
BiblicalUsage: Merizo means to divide, to apportion, to share out, and it is used for inheritances, for gifts, and for Christ Himself. Luke 12:13 has a man ask Jesus to tell his brother to divide the inheritance with him, and 1 Corinthians 1:13 asks, Is Christ divided? 2 Corinthians 10:13 says God distributed to Paul a measure to reach the Corinthians, and Hebrews 7:2 says Abraham gave Melchizedek a tenth part of all.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe dividing is right when God does the apportioning and wrong when man does the splitting: Abraham's tenth honoured a priest, and a divided Christ would honour no one. My position is that the church divides only what God has already joined.
